title: Show how much context window is left
body:
The existing TypeScript CLI shows how much of the available context window has been used. This is valuable information to provide to the user, so we should surface it in the Rust CLI, as well.

Arguably this is even more important once `/compact` is supported: https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/1257.

linked_prs.title: feat: show number of tokens remaining in UI

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves context length management, which is a component of LLM operation issues. It concerns displaying how much of the context window is used, which is crucial for managing LLM behavior and preventing truncated outputs.
